name: Regenerate
description: Level 7 Transmutation (Bard, Doctor, Druid) Casting Time: 1 minute Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a prayer wheel) Duration: 1 hour A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Health. For the duration, the target regains 1 Health at the start of each of its turns, and any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.
